items.title_zh: 中国钢厂盈利走弱，铁矿石期货逼近四年低位
items.title_en: Iron ore futures near four-year lows as Chinese mill profitability weakens
items.title_original: Iron Ore Futures Near Four-Year Low on Weak Chinese Steel Demand
items.summary_zh: IndexBox 10月27日市场简报称，铁矿石期货周一跌向每吨670元人民币，接近四年低位；其引用的行业数据称，上周247家中国钢厂高炉开工率为80%，同比下降4.3%。同时，中国港口到货量偏高、全球发运增加，供应较充裕。报道还提到中国矿产资源集团与力拓达成新的供应安排，但具体条款未公开。
items.summary_en: IndexBox reported on 27 October that iron-ore futures moved toward CNY 670 per tonne on Monday, near four-year lows. It cited an 80% blast-furnace operating rate across 247 Chinese mills last week, down 4.3% year on year, alongside elevated port arrivals and rising global shipments. It also mentioned a new CMRG-Rio Tinto supply arrangement whose terms were not disclosed.
items.impact_zh: 这是市场信号，不是政策文件。原料价格下行有助于降低长流程钢厂采购成本，但其成因同时反映钢材需求和钢厂利润偏弱，不能据一日价格判断出口订单或利润已经改善。钢厂应分别跟踪现货矿价、钢材售价、库存和高炉利润；涉及中矿集团—力拓安排的采购判断，须等待双方可核实披露，不能把媒体所称口头通知当成公开合同条款。
items.impact_en: This is a market signal, not a policy measure. Lower ore prices can reduce blast-furnace input costs, but also reflect weak steel demand and mill margins; one day's price does not establish improved export profitability. Track spot ore, steel prices, inventories and furnace margins separately, and do not treat reported verbal notice of the CMRG-Rio Tinto arrangement as disclosed contract terms.
items.source_excerpt: Iron Ore Futures Near Four-Year Low on Weak Chinese Steel Demand - News and Statistics IndexBox
items.coverage: 2026-10-27已通读IndexBox公开全文，核对670元/吨、247家钢厂、80%开工率、同比下降4.3%及供应描述；这些为媒体引用的市场数据，未独立取得交易所结算表或行业样本底稿。中矿集团—力拓协议条款未公开，未据此推断价格或数量。

items.title_zh: GMK称乌克兰CBAM损失已高于欧委会预测，主张重算影响评估
items.title_en: GMK says Ukraine's CBAM losses already exceed the Commission forecast and calls for a reassessment
items.title_original: CBAM for Ukraine: why the European Commission should revise its impact assessment
items.summary_zh: GMK Center 10月27日分析称，2026年上半年乌克兰对欧盟、覆盖全部CBAM钢铁编码的出口额同比减少1.49亿欧元；其把供应链效应计入后，估算相当于约0.3%的GDP损失。GMK还预计，扁平材平均CBAM支付可能由2026年的78欧元/吨升至2030年的198欧元/吨，长材由61欧元/吨升至173欧元/吨，并主张欧委会把战争破坏、停产、能源和物流约束纳入重新评估。上述数据和预测是GMK模型结果及政策主张，不是欧盟正式豁免或税率决定。欧委会正式报告的基准是到2035年GDP影响约负0.01%，并非GMK文中所写的2031年。
items.summary_en: GMK Center said on 27 October that the value of Ukrainian iron and steel exports to the EU across all CBAM-covered codes fell by EUR 149 million year on year in H1 2026; including supply-chain effects, it estimates a GDP loss of about 0.3%. GMK projects average CBAM payments rising from EUR 78/t in 2026 to EUR 198/t in 2030 for flat products and from EUR 61/t to EUR 173/t for long products, and calls on the Commission to reassess war damage, shutdowns, energy and logistics constraints. These are GMK modelling results and policy requests, not an EU exemption or tariff decision. The Commission's formal report states an estimated GDP effect of about -0.01% by 2035, not 2031 as written in GMK's article.
items.impact_zh: 对中国钢厂的直接规则没有变化。该争议提示，第三国行业会以战争、发展水平和投资能力争取特殊或过渡安排；若乌克兰最终获得可执行优惠，可能改变其钢材在欧盟市场相对中国货源的竞争条件。但中国企业不能据此预期同等待遇，应继续准备经核查的产品级排放数据、测算不同EU ETS价格情景，并在DDP等合同中明确最终CBAM差额和核查失败风险。
items.impact_en: No rule for Chinese steel changes. The dispute shows that third-country industries may seek special or transitional treatment based on war damage, development level and investment capacity; any enforceable Ukraine-specific relief could alter its competitive position versus Chinese supply in the EU. Chinese firms should not assume comparable treatment and should continue preparing verified product-level emissions data, modelling ETS-price scenarios and allocating final CBAM and verification risks in DDP contracts.
items.status: 行业研究与政策主张／非欧盟决定
items.source_excerpt: CBAM for Ukraine: why the European Commission should revise its impact assessment GMK Center
items.coverage: 2026-10-27已通读GMK Center完整英文分析页，核对1.49亿欧元、约0.3% GDP、扁平材78→198欧元/吨、长材61→173欧元/吨及重算诉求；并通读GMK 2026年3月18页研究的核心假设、方法和情景，同时以欧委会COM(2025) 783正式报告核对官方基准。发现GMK本页把欧委会负0.01%预测年份写为2031年，而正式报告为2035年，已在摘要纠正。GMK模型中的企业排放强度并非排放方正式确认，未将其外推为中国产品税额。

follow_up.action_zh: 跟踪欧委会是否正式重开乌克兰CBAM影响评估，以及是否依据《CBAM条例》第30(7)条提出可执行的临时安排；在正式文本发布前不得假定豁免。
follow_up.action_en: Monitor whether the Commission formally reopens its Ukraine CBAM assessment or proposes an enforceable temporary measure under Article 30(7); assume no exemption before an official act.

items.title_zh: 印度商务部长批评欧盟钢铁限制与CBAM：属于谈判立场，不是规则变更
items.title_en: India's commerce minister criticises EU steel curbs and CBAM; remarks do not change the rules
items.title_original: 'EU shooting itself in the foot': Piyush Goyal warns Europe over CBAM, import duty
items.summary_zh: 印度商务与工业部长皮尤什·戈亚尔（Piyush Goyal）在10月22日柏林全球对话上批评欧盟钢铁进口限制、CBAM及其他监管要求，认为这些措施会推高钢、铝、水泥及基础设施成本，削弱欧洲竞争力，并可能引发贸易伙伴的对等措施。他同时强调印度希望获得欧洲电解槽等技术以发展绿氢和绿色钢铁。印度政府官方访问预告确认了戈亚尔10月22日至24日在柏林参加该对话及讨论印欧FTA市场准入，但没有宣布CBAM豁免、钢铁配额调整或新关税决定。
items.summary_en: India's Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal criticised EU steel import restrictions, CBAM and other regulatory requirements at the Berlin Global Dialogue on 22 October, arguing that they could raise steel, aluminium, cement and infrastructure costs, weaken European competitiveness and invite reciprocal measures. He also sought European technology for green hydrogen and green steel. India's official visit notice confirms his Berlin participation and India-EU FTA market-access discussions, but announces no CBAM exemption, quota change or new tariff decision.
items.impact_zh: 这是印度政府的公开政策立场和谈判信号，不改变中国钢材现行欧盟配额、50%超配额税或CBAM义务。中国出口商不应据此假定印度将获得豁免、欧盟会撤回措施，或印欧FTA会自动改变中国产品待遇。应继续按现行CN、原产地、配额和排放规则报价，同时跟踪印欧FTA是否形成针对印度钢材的可执行安排及其对欧盟市场竞争格局的影响。
items.impact_en: This is an Indian policy and negotiating position, not a change to EU treatment of Chinese steel. Chinese exporters should not assume an Indian exemption, EU withdrawal or automatic effect from an India-EU FTA. Continue pricing under current CN, origin, quota and emissions rules, while monitoring any enforceable India-specific outcome and its competitive effect in the EU market.
items.status: 部长公开立场／非政策变更
items.source_excerpt: 'EU shooting itself in the foot': Piyush Goyal warns Europe over CBAM, import duty Business Today
items.coverage: 2026-10-27已通读Business Today全文，并用印度新闻信息局10月21日官方访问公告核对戈亚尔参加柏林全球对话及印欧FTA议程；未发现欧盟或印度发布CBAM豁免、配额调整或关税决定。媒体所称印度出口可能承担20%—35%成本未作为中国订单税率，也未独立验证。

items.title_en: Baosteel Zhanjiang validates low-carbon IF/BH automotive steel with SAIC-GM-Wuling
items.title_original: Baosteel advances low-carbon automotive steel application with SAIC-GM-Wuling Automobile
items.summary_zh: Yieh10月22日报道，宝钢湛江采用氢基竖炉—电炉路线的低碳汽车钢在上汽通用五菱完成应用验证，称白车身按重量超过90%的部件使用低碳钢、钢材相关碳排放减少超过60%。涉及IF无间隙原子钢及BH烘烤硬化钢，用于侧围、车门外板等重视成形性和表面质量的部件。比例及减排数字均为报道披露。

items.impact_zh: 中国汽车钢供应商应关注低碳性能与成形质量同步验证的采购趋势；90%是材料覆盖重量比例，60%是报道的钢材相关减排，均不是整车全生命周期或CBAM法定减免比例。出口仍需对应装置和年度核查数据。
items.impact_en: Customer qualification requires formability and surface quality as well as carbon performance. Material coverage and steel-related savings are not whole-vehicle or CBAM relief percentages.

items.title_zh: 欧洲热卷：北欧钢厂一季度报800—830欧元/吨，CBAM资金占用压制采购
items.title_en: European HRC: Nordic Q1 offers at EUR 800–830/t as CBAM working-capital needs weigh on buying
items.title_original: [SMM Steel] European HRC: Nordic Mills Push Higher Q1 Offers, CBAM Capital Tie-Up and High Stocks Drag Buying Momentum
items.summary_zh: SMM 10月22日市场报告称，北欧主要钢厂对2027年2—3月交付的热卷报价为800—830欧元/吨DDP；西北欧热卷评估价维持740欧元/吨EXW，意大利市场降1欧元至743欧元/吨EXW。报道认为终端需求偏弱、库存偏高，同时CBAM证书余额要求占用买方和贸易商流动资金，抑制补库。欧委会CBAM Registry页面确认系统已提供监测“50%规则”的功能；但SMM所称“预购并冻结至少全年义务的50%”是媒体对资金影响的概括，不应替代法规的季度账户余额计算。
items.summary_en: SMM reported on 22 October that major Nordic mills offered HRC for February-March 2027 delivery at EUR 800-830/t DDP; Northwest European HRC was assessed at EUR 740/t EXW and Italian HRC at EUR 743/t EXW, down EUR 1. It attributed weak restocking to soft end demand, high inventories and the working-capital effect of CBAM certificate-balance requirements. The Commission's CBAM Registry page confirms tools for monitoring the '50% rule', but SMM's description of pre-purchasing and freezing 50% of annual obligations is a media characterisation, not a substitute for the legal quarterly account-balance calculation.
items.impact_zh: 这是一份市场报价与采购情绪报告，不是官方基准价格或新法规。对中国热卷出口商而言，欧盟买方可能把CBAM证书持有和融资成本计入报价、付款条件或采购节奏；企业应给客户提供可核查的实际排放资料，并分别测算EXW/DDP、配额和CBAM资金成本。不得把800—830欧元/吨视为全欧统一成交价，也不得据此给中国订单加上固定“50%融资附加费”。
items.impact_en: This is a market and sentiment report, not an official benchmark or new law. EU buyers may incorporate CBAM certificate holdings and financing costs into quotations, payment terms or purchasing schedules. Chinese HRC exporters should provide verifiable actual-emissions data and model EXW/DDP, quota and CBAM working-capital effects separately. Do not treat EUR 800-830/t as a Europe-wide transaction price or add a fixed '50% financing surcharge' to Chinese orders.
items.source_excerpt: [SMM Steel] European HRC: Nordic Mills Push Higher Q1 Offers, CBAM Capital Tie-Up and High Stocks Drag Buying Momentum Shanghai Metals Market
items.coverage: 2026-10-27已通读SMM公开全文，核对800—830欧元/吨DDP、740和743欧元/吨EXW及市场判断；报价为SMM市场沟通和内部模型处理数据，未独立取得钢厂正式报价单或成交记录。另核对欧委会CBAM Registry官方页面对50%规则监测功能的说明；未把SMM的“预购/冻结全年义务”表述当作精确法律定义。

follow_up.action_zh: 跟踪2027年一季度实际成交价、欧委会50%规则操作指南及买方合同条款；只有法规或官方指南变化时才更新合规口径。
follow_up.action_en: Track Q1 2027 transaction prices, Commission operational guidance on the 50% rule and buyer contract terms; change compliance assumptions only on official guidance or legislation.

items.title_zh: 欧盟就ETS市场稳定储备达成临时政治协议：保留上限拟由4亿增至7亿配额
items.title_en: Provisional EU ETS deal would raise the MSR retention buffer from 400m to 700m allowances
items.title_original: Commission welcomes political agreement on rules enhancing stability and long-term resilience of EU carbon market
items.summary_zh: 欧委会10月21日新闻稿IP/26/2206确认议会与理事会达成临时政治协议，拟将市场稳定储备（MSR）可保留的配额缓冲由4亿提高至7亿。现行规则对超过4亿的储备配额作废。协议仍须双方正式通过并在欧盟公报发布后生效，与7月17日提出的更广泛ETS/MSR改革分别推进。
items.summary_en: Commission release IP/26/2206 of 21 October confirms a provisional Parliament–Council deal to retain up to 700 million allowances in the MSR, rather than invalidate holdings above 400 million. Formal adoption and Official Journal publication remain necessary. The broader July ETS/MSR review is separate.
items.impact_zh: 增加的是储备缓冲，并非立即向市场投放3亿配额，也不是CBAM免征或税率下调。钢厂应跟进正式文本及后续供给规则；出口报价仍用适用期官方购证价格和产品排放数据。
items.impact_en: Retention is not an immediate release of 300 million allowances or a CBAM exemption. Track adoption and use applicable official certificate prices in export estimates.
items.status: 临时政治协议／待正式通过
items.source_excerpt: The European Commission welcomes the provisional political agreement reached by the European Parliament and the Council on a targeted amendment to strengthen the Market Stability Reserve (MSR) of the EU's Emissions Trading System (EU ETS).

items.title_zh: 南非研究：CBAM冲击取决于产品排放强度与进口价格，不宜只看国家平均值
items.title_en: South African study says CBAM exposure depends on product emissions and import prices, not country averages alone
items.title_original: LAWRENCE EDWARDS AND NICOLA WILLS | The CBAM wake-up call: decarbonisation is now an export survival issue
items.summary_zh: Business Day刊发开普敦大学Lawrence Edwards与Nicola Wills的评论，基于ERSA产品层面局部均衡研究。作者指出，同类产品的排放强度可在国家和企业间显著不同，固定的每吨碳成本对低价、高排放产品造成的价格涨幅更大。其南非情景以80欧元/吨CO₂e并计入直接与间接排放时，模拟钢铁平均欧盟进口价格上升约31%；直接排放情景下南非钢铁进口量约降48%，纳入间接排放后约降76%。这些是南非模型结果，不是对中国产品的税额或销量预测。
items.summary_en: Business Day published commentary by UCT researchers Lawrence Edwards and Nicola Wills based on an ERSA product-level partial-equilibrium study. They argue that emissions vary across products and firms, while a fixed carbon cost causes a larger percentage price increase for cheaper, emissions-intensive goods. In their South African scenario using EUR 80/tCO2e and both direct and indirect emissions, the model raises average EU import prices for iron and steel by about 31%; estimated South African steel imports fall about 48% with direct emissions only and 76% when indirect emissions are included. These are South African model results, not Chinese duty or volume forecasts.
items.impact_zh: 对中国钢厂的可用启示是，应按产品、装置和工艺准备实际排放数据，并把产品单价、排放强度和客户替代弹性一起纳入欧盟报价情景；提升产品附加值可以降低固定碳成本占售价的比例。但不得把文中的31%、48%或76%直接套用于中国订单。若欧盟未来正式纳入更多间接排放，应再依据最终法规、CN范围、实际排放和届时EU ETS价格重算。
items.impact_en: For Chinese mills, the useful lesson is to model EU quotations using product-, installation- and process-level verified emissions together with unit value and demand substitution. Higher-value products may reduce the carbon charge as a share of price. Do not apply the article's 31%, 48% or 76% South African estimates to Chinese orders. Recalculate only against final EU rules, CN scope, actual emissions and the relevant ETS price if indirect-emissions coverage changes.

items.title_zh: 韩国对中国合金钢棒作肯定性反倾销初裁，临时税率仍待财政部门决定
items.title_en: South Korea preliminarily finds injury from Chinese alloy-steel bars; provisional duties await finance-ministry action
items.title_original: China Steel Bar Duties Near, Squeezing Small Forging Firms
items.summary_zh: 韩国贸易委员会于2026年9月17日第477次会议对中国合金钢棒作出倾销和产业损害肯定性初裁，并建议财政经济部门在调查期间征收25.08%—27.96%的临时反倾销税。涉案棒材用于汽车、工程机械、造船、轴承和工业机械零部件；申请人为世亚贝斯特与世亚昌原特殊钢，调查对象包括中国大冶、江苏永钢和金腾三组供应商。委员会预计于2027年2月作出终裁。该初裁及建议不等同于临时税已经生效。
items.summary_en: At its 477th meeting on 17 September 2026, the Korea Trade Commission made an affirmative preliminary dumping and injury determination on alloy-steel bars from China and recommended provisional anti-dumping duties of 25.08%–27.96% during the investigation. The bars are used in automotive, construction-equipment, shipbuilding, bearing and industrial-machinery parts. SeAH Besteel and SeAH Changwon Special Steel filed the petition; the investigated supplier groups include Daye, Jiangsu Yonggang and Jinteng. A final determination is planned for February 2027. The preliminary finding and recommendation do not by themselves put provisional duties into force.
items.impact_zh: 对韩出口合金钢棒的中国生产商和贸易商应立即按韩国书面产品范围核对牌号、制造方式、HSK编码、生产商—出口商组合及关联企业，并保存内销、对韩销售、成本和产能数据以应对后续核查。报价和到港安排不得直接套用媒体列示的企业税率；只有韩国财政部门发布实施公告后，才能确认临时税的生效日、征收期和报关适用税率。同步跟踪2027年2月终裁节点。
items.impact_en: Chinese producers and traders exporting alloy-steel bars to Korea should immediately map grades, manufacturing method, HSK codes, producer-exporter combinations and affiliates against the written scope, and preserve home-market sales, Korean sales, cost and capacity data for the continuing investigation. Do not apply media-reported company rates to quotations or arrivals until the Korean finance authority publishes an implementing notice confirming the effective date, collection period and entry rate. Monitor the planned February 2027 final determination.

items.summary_zh: 首钢股份公告编号2026-047显示，公司拟以自有及自筹资金，按5.1269元/股受让首钢智新11家股东合计587,911,257股，占首钢智新总股本19.60%，预计总价不超过30.15亿元。若按拟议范围完成，首钢股份持股比例将由66.23%升至85.83%，仍为控股股东。九届八次董事会已于2026年10月15日通过，关联董事回避表决；交易构成关联交易、不构成重大资产重组，仍须2026年11月3日临时股东会批准，最终股份数量和价款还取决于实际签署协议。
items.summary_en: Announcement No. 2026-047 says Shougang Co. proposes to acquire 587,911,257 shares in Shougang Zhixin from 11 shareholders at CNY 5.1269 per share, representing 19.60% of the subsidiary, for up to CNY 3.015 billion using internal and raised funds. If completed as proposed, its stake would rise from 66.23% to 85.83%. The board approved the related-party transaction on 15 October 2026 with related directors abstaining; it is not a major asset restructuring but still requires approval at the extraordinary shareholders' meeting on 3 November. Final shares and consideration depend on executed agreements.
items.impact_zh: 这项交易首先是控股权和治理结构调整，不等同于新增30.15亿元电工钢产能，也不会直接改变出口关税、CBAM或产品认证。若获批并完成，少数股东权益下降、决策权进一步集中，可能有利于高端取向及无取向电工钢研发、产能升级和全产业链协同；但具体产量、产品组合、资本开支和客户供货变化仍须以后续项目及经营公告为准。业务团队应在11月3日后核对股东会结果及最终协议，再更新对客户的产能和供应判断。
items.impact_en: This is primarily a control and governance transaction, not CNY 3.015 billion of new electrical-steel capacity, and it does not directly change tariffs, CBAM treatment or product approvals. If approved and completed, greater control may support R&D, capacity upgrades and value-chain coordination in high-grade grain-oriented and non-oriented electrical steel, but output, product mix, capex and customer-supply effects require later operating disclosures. Recheck the shareholder vote and final agreements after 3 November before changing customer-facing capacity or supply assumptions.

items.source_excerpt: Find out how sector-level CBAM rates are calculated under the CBAM rate methodology using illustrative rates and worked example. The UK Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism ( CBAM ) is designed to address the risk of carbon leakage as the UK decarbonises its economy. It does this by applying a carbon price to imported goods in covered sectors that reflects the carbon price faced by comparable domestic production. Unlike most taxes, CBAM does not have a single headline rate set out in primary legislation. Instead, the rate is determined using a methodology that combines recent carbon pricing data, sector-level emissions information and the extent to which domestic producers continue to receive free allowances under the UK Emissions Trading Scheme. This methodology is set out in law, via the Finance Act 2026. The purpose of this note is to explain how sector-level CBAM rates are calculated under the CBAM rate methodology. items.summary_zh: 10月15日问答的钢铁问题4.11、4.31说明：切割等排除工序不计其工序排放，但前体仍按进入工序、切割前质量核算；再加热、再熔、铸造、热冷轧、锻造、酸洗、退火、涂覆、镀锌、拉丝等属于相关系统边界，电镀、切割、焊接及精整排除。财务章节确认2026年对应购证自2027年2月开始，2026年度首次申报及清缴为2027年9月30日；购证量须考虑免费配额调整及有效已付碳价。
items.summary_en: The 15 October Q&A says excluded cutting emissions do not permit using only post-cut precursor mass. Relevant boundaries include rolling, forging, pickling, annealing, coating, galvanising and drawing; plating, cutting, welding and finishing are excluded. Certificate sales start February 2027; the first 2026 annual declaration and surrender are due 30 September 2027, with free-allocation and eligible paid-carbon-price adjustments.
items.impact_zh: 钢厂应统一前体投入重量、成品产量和外包工序台账，不能只以出口净重回推全部排放。为欧盟客户预留2027年购证资金和年度核查时间；问答为解释材料，个案仍依现行法规及正式指南。
items.impact_en: Reconcile precursor input, output and outsourced processing and plan verified data and buyer funding. The Q&A explains rules; it is not a substitute for governing legislation.
